title: Essential Greetings & Politeness (ಮೂಲ ನಮಸ್ಕಾರಗಳು)
description: Master everyday greetings, asking how someone is, polite words like thank you and please in Kannada.

content_json.objective: Learn to greet people, ask 'How are you?', and say 'Thank you' with respect in Kannada.

vocabulary.example: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀರ? (Hello, how are you?)
ಸರ್, ನೀವು ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀರ? (Sir, how are you?)
ನಾನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದ್ದೀನಿ. (I am doing well.)
ತುಂಬಾ ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು. (Thank you very much.)
ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಒಳಗೆ ಬನ್ನಿ. (Please come inside.)
ಹೌದು, ನನಗೆ ಬೇಕು. (Yes, I want it.)

grammar_notes.en: In Kannada, verbs change endings depending on respect. 'ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀರ?' (Hegiddira) is polite and respectful (addressed to elders, strangers, or plural). 'ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀಯ?' (Hegiddiya) is informal for close friends or kids.
grammar_notes.hi: कन्नड़ में सम्मान देने के लिए क्रिया के अंत में 'ira' जुड़ता है जैसे 'ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀರ?' (आप कैसे हैं?), जबकि दोस्तों के लिए 'ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀಯ?' (तू कैसा है?) प्रयुक्त होता है।
grammar_notes.mr: कन्नडमध्ये आदराने बोलण्यासाठी 'ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀರ?' (तुम्ही कसे आहात?) वापरतात, आणि लहानांसाठी किंवा मित्रांसाठी 'ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀಯ?' वापरतात.

exercises.question: Match the Kannada greeting to its English meaning:
exercises.explanation: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ is Hello, ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು means Thank you, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು means Please, and ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದ್ದೀನಿ means I am fine.

exercises.question: Complete the response: 'ನಾನು ________' (I am fine).
exercises.explanation: The proper response to 'Hegiddira?' is 'Nānu cennāgiddīni' (I am fine).

exercises.question: How do you politely ask 'How are you?' in Kannada?
exercises.explanation: 'ಹೇಗಿದ್ದೀರ?' (Hēgiddīra?) is the polite and universally accepted way to ask 'How are you?'.

exercises.prompt: Someone opens the door and says: 'ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ! ಬನ್ನಿ.' How do you reply politely?
exercises.explanation: A polite acknowledgement returned with greetings and thanks is the standard etiquette.

title: Numbers, Quantities & Common Objects (ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವಸ್ತುಗಳು)
description: Learn numbers 1 to 10, asking prices, and essential everyday items in Kannada.

content_json.objective: Count from one to ten and ask 'How much?' or specify quantities in Kannada.

vocabulary.example: ಎರಡು ಚಹಾ ಕೊಡಿ. (Give two teas.)
ಹತ್ತು ರೂಪಾಯಿ. (Ten rupees.)
ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ರೂಪಾಯಿ? (How many rupees for this?)
ಇದು ಏನು? (What is this?)
ಕುಡಿಯಲು ನೀರು ಕೊಡಿ. (Give drinking water.)

grammar_notes.en: To ask for an item politely, state the item followed by 'ಕೊಡಿ' (Kodi - Give/please give). E.g., 'ನೀರು ಕೊಡಿ' (Neeru kodi = Please give water).
grammar_notes.hi: कन्नड़ में सम्मान से कुछ माँगने के लिए वस्तु के नाम के बाद 'ಕೊಡಿ' (कोडि - दीजिए) लगाएँ। जैसे 'ನೀರು ಕೊಡಿ' (पानी दीजिए)।
grammar_notes.mr: कोणतीही गोष्ट मागताना शब्दाच्या शेवटी 'ಕೊಡಿ' (कोडी - द्या) लावावे. उदा. 'ನೀರು ಕೊಡಿ' (पाणी द्या).

exercises.question: Fill the blank to say 'How much is this?': 'ಇದು ________?'
exercises.explanation: 'Idu eṣṭu?' translates directly to 'How much is this?'.

exercises.question: Translate to Kannada: 'Please give water.'
exercises.explanation: 'ನೀರು' (Nīru) = Water, 'ಕೊಡಿ' (Koḍi) = Give please.

exercises.prompt: You are at a tea stall and want to order 2 cups of tea. What do you say?
exercises.explanation: Eraḍu (2) + cahā (tea) + koḍi (please give).

title: Expressing Needs: Bēku & Bēḍa (ಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಬೇಡ)
description: Learn the most powerful Kannada words 'Bēku' (want/need) and 'Bēḍa' (don't want/don't need).

content_json.objective: Express what you want, what you don't want, and ask others what they require.

vocabulary.example: ನನಗೆ ಕಾಫಿ ಬೇಕು. (I want coffee.)
ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಬೇಡ. (Sugar not needed / don't put sugar.)
ನನಗೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಮಯ ಬೇಕು. (I need some time.)
ನಿಮಗೆ ಏನು ಬೇಕು? (What do you want?)
ನನಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಗೊತ್ತು. (I know a little Kannada.)

grammar_notes.en: In Kannada, when using 'bēku' or 'gottu', the subject takes the dative case (-ge): 'ನನಗೆ' (nanage = to me) rather than 'ನಾನು' (nānu = I). For example: 'Nanage kannada gottilla' (I don't know Kannada).
grammar_notes.hi: हिंदी की तरह जैसे हम 'मुझे चाहिए' कहते हैं (मैं चाहिए नहीं), वैसे ही कन्नड़ में 'ನನಗೆ ಬೇಕು' (ननगे बेकु) कहा जाता है।
grammar_notes.mr: मराठीप्रमाणेच 'मला हवे आहे' म्हणताना 'ನನಗೆ ಬೇಕು' (ननगे बेकू) वापरले जाते.

exercises.question: Match the core desire words:
exercises.explanation: ಬೇಕು is want, ಬೇಡ is don't want, ಗೊತ್ತು is know, and ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ is don't know.

exercises.question: Say 'I don't want sugar': 'ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ________.'
exercises.explanation: 'Bēḍa' means don't want or not required.

exercises.question: How do you say 'I know a little Kannada'?
exercises.explanation: 'Nanage' (to me) + 'kannaḍa' + 'svalpa' (little) + 'gottu' (know).

exercises.prompt: The waiter asks: 'ನಿಮಗೆ ಚಹಾ ಬೇಕಾ?' (Do you want tea?). You prefer coffee instead. How do you answer?
exercises.suggested_response: ಚಹಾ ಬೇಡ, ನನಗೆ ಕಾಫಿ ಬೇಕು. (Cahā bēḍa, nanage kāfi bēku.)
exercises.explanation: Tea not needed, I want coffee.

title: Practical Shopping & Market Interactions (ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆ)
description: Navigate vegetable markets, grocery shops, and street vendors with natural Kannada.

content_json.objective: Ask for item varieties, check freshness, negotiate respectfully, and request a carry bag.

vocabulary.example: ತರಕಾರಿ ತಾಜಾ ಇದೆಯಾ? (Are the vegetables fresh?)

vocabulary.english: Please reduce the price a little
vocabulary.example: ತುಂಬಾ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ. (Too expensive, please reduce a little.)
ಒಂದು ಕವರ್ ಅಥವಾ ಬ್ಯಾಗ್ ಕೊಡಿ. (Please give a bag.)
ಒಂದು ಕೆಜಿ ಈರುಳ್ಳಿ ಕೊಡಿ. (Give one kg onions.)

grammar_notes.en: Adding 'ಆ' (ā) at the end of a sentence turns a statement into a question. 'ಇದೆ' (ide = it is there) -> 'ಇದೆಯಾ?' (ideyā? = is it there?).
grammar_notes.hi: क्रिया के अंत में 'आ' स्वर जोड़ने से वाक्य प्रश्न बन जाता है: 'ಇದೆ' (है) -> 'ಇದೆಯಾ?' (क्या है?).
grammar_notes.mr: वाक्याच्या शेवटी 'आ' जोडल्यास प्रश्न तयार होतो: 'ಇದೆ' (आहे) -> 'ಇದೆಯಾ?' (आहे का?).

exercises.question: Match the market phrases:
exercises.explanation: ತಾಜಾ ಇದೆಯಾ? = Is it fresh?, ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ = Reduce price, ಬ್ಯಾಗ್ ಕೊಡಿ = Give bag.

exercises.question: To ask 'Do you have a bag?', you say: 'ಬ್ಯಾಗ್ ________?'
exercises.explanation: 'ideyā?' turns 'it is there' into 'is it there?'.

exercises.question: Translate: 'Give one kg tomatoes.'
exercises.explanation: 'Ondu kēji' (one kg) + 'ṭomyāṭo' + 'koḍi' (please give).

exercises.prompt: The vendor quotes ₹100 for apples. You feel it is high. Politely ask them to reduce the price.
exercises.suggested_response: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಆಯ್ತು, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಸರ್. (Svalpa jāsti āytu, svalpa kaḍime māḍi sar.)
exercises.explanation: Respectfully pointing out that it is a bit high and asking for a slight reduction.

title: Directions, Auto & Metro Commuting (ದಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಚಾರ)
description: Navigate Bengaluru traffic, ride Namma Metro, and communicate smoothly with auto drivers.

content_json.objective: Instruct drivers on routes, understand navigation terms, and confirm fare meters.

vocabulary.example: ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಮೀಟರ್ ಹಾಕಿ ಹೋಗಿ. (Please go by meter.)
ಮುಂದೆ ಸಿಗ್ನಲ್ ವರೆಗೆ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಹೋಗಿ. (Go straight till the next signal.)

vocabulary.english: To the left / To the right
vocabulary.example: ಮುಂದೆ ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗಿ. (Turn left ahead.)
ಗೇಟ್ ಮುಂದೆ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ. (Stop here in front of the gate.)

grammar_notes.en: Direction suffixes: '-kke' indicates towards (eḍa = left, eḍakke = to the left; bala = right, balakke = to the right).
grammar_notes.hi: दिशा बताने के लिए '-kke' प्रत्यय लगता है: ಎಡ (बायाँ) -> ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ (बाईं ओर), ಬಲ (दायाँ) -> ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ (दायीं ओर)।
grammar_notes.mr: दिशेसाठी '-kke' प्रत्यय लागतो: ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ (डाव्या बाजूला), ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ (उजव्या बाजूला).

exercises.question: Match commute directions:
exercises.explanation: Essential transit directions every resident in Karnataka uses.

exercises.question: Tell the auto driver to stop: 'ಇಲ್ಲಿ ________.'
exercises.explanation: 'Nillisi' means stop.

exercises.question: Translate: 'Go straight and turn right.'
exercises.explanation: 'Nēravāgi hōgi' (go straight) + 'balakke tirugi' (turn right).

exercises.prompt: You have reached your destination. Tell the driver to stop here and ask how much the fare is.
exercises.suggested_response: ಇಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ ಸರ್. ಎಷ್ಟು ಆಯ್ತು? (Illi nillisi sar. Eṣṭu āytu?)
exercises.explanation: Stop here sir. How much is the fare?

title: Confident Conversations: Work & Social Life (ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸದ ಸಂಭಾಷಣೆ)
description: Express opinions, participate in workplace conversations, and build lasting friendships in Kannada.

content_json.objective: Discuss plans, offer assistance, handle workplace exchanges, and converse smoothly without hesitation.

vocabulary.example: ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ? (Could you please help for a minute?)
ನನ್ನ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಇದು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಉಪಾಯ. (In my opinion this is a great idea.)
ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ಎಲ್ಲರ ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ? (Hello everyone, did you have your meal?)
ಇವತ್ತಿನ ಮಾತುಕತೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿತ್ತು, ಮತ್ತೆ ಸಿಗೋಣ! (Today's chat was wonderful, see you again!)

grammar_notes.en: 'ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ?' (Ūṭa āytā?) is the warmest everyday cultural greeting in Karnataka, equivalent to asking 'How are you?' over lunch hours.
grammar_notes.hi: कर्नाटक में 'ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ?' (खाना हुआ क्या?) पूछना केवल खाने के बारे में नहीं, बल्कि अपनापन और कुशलक्षेम जताने का सबसे प्यारा तरीक़ा है।
grammar_notes.mr: कर्नाटकात 'ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ?' (जेवलात का?) विचारणे हे आपुलकी आणि स्नेहाचे मुख्य लक्षण मानले जाते.

exercises.question: Match conversational fluency expressions:
exercises.explanation: Polite expressions used in professional and social everyday settings.

exercises.question: Complete the friendly goodbye: 'ತುಂಬಾ ಸಂತೋಷ, ಮತ್ತೆ ________.'
exercises.explanation: 'Matte sigōṇa' means let's meet again / see you again.

exercises.question: Translate: 'Can you please help me for a minute?'
exercises.explanation: 'Dayaviṭṭu' (please) + 'ondu nimiṣa' (one minute) + 'sahāya māḍtīrā?' (can you help?).

exercises.prompt: Your colleague greets you in the afternoon asking 'ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ?'. How do you reply in natural Kannada?
exercises.suggested_response: ಹೌದು, ಆಯ್ತು! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ? (Haudu, āytu! Nimma ūṭa āytā?)
exercises.explanation: Yes, done! Did you have yours?
